desc:
🌲 Welcome to CHB! 🌲 

Located on the north shore of Long Island, this sanctuary has been a refuge for Greek demigods for over a century. Train and grow with your fellow campers to fend off against the many mythological monsters and deadly deities that threaten your very existence. Perhaps one day, you'll be able to survive on your own. 
Based off of Rick Riordan's Percy Jackson & the Olympians, and Heroes of Olympus book series.

This is a roleplay game. Design a character, tell a story, explore secret locations in the map, and even acquire collectables! 
⭐Join the group for in-game benefits!⭐

If you're looking to buy universal passes (Accessories, Outfits, Custom Mesh), you can purchase them from our other games. 

#chb #percyjackson
